question: What is Imaginary Moonbase Holdings' completed spending if there are no matching orders?
sql: SELECT c.name AS name, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price, 2)), 0), 2) AS total_spending_sek FROM public.customers AS c LEFT JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'completed' LEFT JOIN public.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE c.name = 'Imaginary Moonbase Holdings' GROUP BY c.name;
